en.abdullah-al-shahin: (9) Abdul Wahid bin Abdullah narrated from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Rabah az-Zuhri from Muhammad bin al-Abbas bin Eessa al-Husayni from al-Hasan bin Ali bin Abu Hamza from his father from Malik bin A’yun al-Juhani that Imam Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said: “
Every banner that is raised before the banner of al-Qa’im will be of an oppressive arrogant.”
